integrity: The two-cycle is proved from the source's exact factor-level polar update and a covariance matrix that satisfies the source model's feasibility relation. The bundled numerical replay is supplementary. Full-text comparison includes the motivating river-valley source and two highly relevant Muon convergence/preconditioning papers; residual literature risk is disclosed.
scientific_limitations: Exact simplified Muon, fixed step, no momentum or stochastic noise; an explicit one-parameter coupled interaction family rather than a classification of all positive-semidefinite interactions. The third nuisance coordinate is decoupled. No attraction or genericity claim is made.
title: An exact coupled period-two orbit for fixed-step simplified Muon
